title: gwb_ceilings: code and reproducibility package for "Energetic Ceilings and Benchmarks of Astrophysical Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds"
description:
Code accompanying Mingarelli (2026), "Energetic Ceilings and Benchmarks of Astrophysical Gravitational-Wave Backgrounds" (arXiv:2601.18859).

The repository contains (1) the paper's reproducibility package (reproducibility/): the deterministic six-channel benchmark calculation, the SMBHB merger-factor inference from published summary values, regression tests, detector inputs with documented provenance and SHA-256 hashes, frozen reference results, and the builders for the three manuscript figures; and (2) an interactive Streamlit application (app.py) for exploring how gravitational-wave-background amplitudes scale with the available mass reservoirs.

The software is released under the MIT license. The third-party detector data files in reproducibility/data/detectors/ are redistributed with full provenance and are not covered by the software license; see REDISTRIBUTION_CLEARANCE.md in that directory for their terms.
